study_design: Pooled analysis of six Finnish population-based cohort studies
cohort_total_n_excerpt: We used data from six Finnish population-based cohort studies with data collected between 1972 and 2015 that included a total of 82,570 male participants.
reason: The cohort analysis evaluates incidence of prostate cancer overall. The abstract does not define or analyze aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal prostate cancer incidence.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The hazard ratio (HR) of PCa incidence was 1.18 (95% CI 1.02 - 1.36) for light alcohol consumers, 1.20 (95% CI 1.03 - 1.40) for moderate consumers, and 1.32 (95% CI 1.08 - 1.60) for heavy consumers.
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported hazard ratio is for overall prostate cancer incidence, not an aggressive prostate cancer subtype.
